What if you sat on a thick wallet every day?
Back pocket wallets are a habit for millions of people. Most people never even notice it. Lots of people carry cards, cash and receipts all in one.

But here's the twist. It tilts your hips, and it can press on the sciatic nerve, causing pain all the way down your leg. Doctors even call it wallet neuritis! Moving your wallet to a front pocket is an easy fix. Sitting unevenly for hours can also strain your lower back.
